Tests that Runtime.evaluate with generatePreview does not crash when assigning a cyclic object to undefined and evaluating an undeclared variable. Bug 64155.
var x = {a:1}; x.self = x; undefined = x;
{
    description : Object
    overflow : false
    properties : [
        [0] : {
            name : a
            type : number
            value : 1
        }
        [1] : {
            name : self
            type : object
            value : Object
        }
    ]
    type : object
}
unknownVar
{
    className : ReferenceError
    description : ReferenceError: unknownVar is not defined     at <anonymous>:1:1
    text : Uncaught
}
